label: B25-DDR-CONTROL-GOLDEN-ONLY-RECOVERY
title: Restore exact golden after the successful DDR m control without rerunning candidate or terminal
dependency_exception: T-20260920-041 passed candidate and DDR acceptance but its sole golden attempt failed. This successor consumes that preserved failure and must not rerun candidate, terminal or m.
authorization: Existing user authorization and active microbench goal require final exact golden; scope is exactly one volatile golden programmer transaction plus one final read-only chain enumeration.
scope: Fresh-bootstrap one task-owned root, AST/seal the exact T-036 recovery bundle, invoke program_once.ps1 once in golden mode, fetch the result, and only after success enumerate jtagconfig -n once through the preserved standard server.
acceptance: One durable golden marker and one successful golden programmer result with exact file/checksum/JTAG ID, followed by one final chain enumeration matching exact golden design hash and UART/PHY. Candidate, terminal and m counts remain zero.
failure_policy: One attempt only. Any setup, program or enumeration failure ends with live state unproven; no retry, reset, power or Flash action.

dispatch.monitoring: single direct recovery; no polling restart or retry

result.final_chain: PASS; exact cable, 02E060DD, golden design hash, JTAG UART #0 and JTAG PHY #0
result.wrapper_note: exit1 only because matcher required optional 0x prefix; raw final enumeration passes
